independent_checks.valid: r_tvalid recorded only as diagnostic under contract; outer DUT interfaces consume dout directly and drive input valid constantly. Numeric characterization does not claim handshakes or latency.

sequenced_gate.fixed_source: Do not modify this sealed source, regenerateIP,replaceFP model,rewrite table or rerun acceptedScorer/CPU. Any compiler failure ends this gate and requires new source cause review.

static.precondition: Fresh existing build directory; bound source/library/tool hashes pass. Execute under guard_runtime_4g.py with exact requested limits and process policy.
static.success_gate: All seven VHDL and outerVerilog compile; TB elaborates without missing/blackbox modules; full static snapshot manifest exists; source post-binding passes. Preserve and classify warnings. If these hold, runtime below is already authorized with no further approval.

runtime.precondition: Only clean static success described above; fresh existing runtime dir; recheck source and exact immutable static snapshot before launch.
runtime.behavior: One full119-case run,not stop-on-first-numeric-mismatch; preserve all rawbits and original first mismatch; complete marker is not conformancePASS. No source/gold adaptation during or after run.
runtime.completion: Snapshot source binding and allowed-runtime-file archive required even if XSim/run script returns nonzero. A finite R0 bit mismatch is a characterization result to analyze, not an excuse to rerun or change gold.

offline_raw_audit.condition: After archive/source/snapshot preservation,run once whenever raw data exists including expected numeric-conformance fatal or incomplete-run failure. Its nonzero result is preserved; no rerun. No simulator continued after resource/policy failure.

snapshot_contract.pre_static: Bind complete source before and after elaboration. Record every regular snapshot file and symlink target.
snapshot_contract.post_runtime: Before any cleanup archive/hash all four allowed files that exist. Rehash every original compiled file and require exact identity; only these four paths may appear/change. Obtain post-binding without --expected-snapshot-report,then independently compare manifests with whitelist; verifier exact equality would otherwise reject new runtime files. If removing added files for an exact-check convenience,first archive,never delete/alter any preexisting compiled file.
snapshot_contract.failure: Full raw logs,argv/cwd,all exit codes,guards,timeline,policy,partial/final snapshot and rawfile completeness saved on all outcomes; no unbound mutable exception.

sequenced_gate.budget_basis: Seven wrappers and roughly4197 scheduled warmup/test clocks fit65536 hardwarewatchdog; budgets are finite environment allowances rather than latency predictions.4GiB includes verifier whole-file reading of inherited~2GB secureip as well as smallFP elaboration. No Scorer6000s budget inherited.

acceptance_after_run: Astra independently reviews all119 raw records,first mismatch/all categories,source/snapshot identity and tool/resource outcome. Never infer universal FTZ from one case or C_HAS_UNDERFLOW; no C1 implementation/numerical waiver or overall restore/quant acceptance here.
reviewer_execution: Source/code reading,streamed hashes,literal table andSV correspondence only; no numerical oracle or EDA.
